_about: The content autopilot's allow-list of sources and the fixed words it puts around what it writes (services/newsroom_autopilot.py). Feed addresses and on/off are settings (autopilot.source.<id>.url / .enabled); a feed address must stay on the source's hosts. 'verified' says what was checked from the network and when; empty means no public RSS or Atom feed was found yet.
